nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Super Multi-Corrective Eye Zone Treatment

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report strong hydration around the eyes and, in one case, some residual dryness after use, with severe dry skin cited as a case where the cream outperformed dermatologist recommendations.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say the cream does not irritate, sting or burn even around sensitive eyes, while others report burning, swelling, itching, or increased sensitivity and pain when washing after use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination/sensitive skin broke out with the regular formula but had no issue after switching to the soft-cream version.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (50s–70s) report smoother eyelids, fewer fine lines and wrinkles, reduced puffiness and dark circles, and compliments on looking younger, though one 52-year-old found the texture tacky and hard to blend.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visible softening of fine lines, wrinkles and crow's feet, smoother eyelids and a fresher, younger look over weeks to months; a few say they saw no improvement after 30 days or found the previous formula more effective.
concerns.dehydration: Many describe the eye area as hydrated, moisturized and non-tight after use, but one reviewer with dry skin noted the product left the area a little dry.
concerns.redness: One reviewer developed red, swollen, itchy under-eyes; most others report no redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report no stinging, burning or irritation and describe the area as calmed and soothed, while a smaller group reports burning, excessive tearing, or heightened sensitivity after use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes the cream lightens dark spots and brightens the under-eye area; this is not widely echoed.
concerns.blemishes: One combination-skin reviewer broke out using the regular formula but resolved this by switching to the soft-cream version; no other breakout reports appear.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers across skin types describe the texture as absorbing quickly without greasiness or oily residue; no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: No fragrance, well tolerated near eyes
Sticky residue, hard to blend or wear makeup over
Good value, small amount goes a long way

extraits.titre: Beware if you have sensitive skin
extraits.texte: Here's an edited version of your review: --- I have sensitive skin, and this product made the skin under my eyes start burning almost immediately. I quickly wiped most of the product off, but I woke up to very swollen, red, and itchy under eyes and eyelids.

I love kiehls products. Sadly this was is a hard no for me. I started using it and then I would wake up the next morning with puffy undereyes, itchy ness and dry patches. I stopped using for a while to see if this was the cause, I used it again a couple weeks later and the same thing happened. and I'm not sensitive to skincare products at all. This wasn't cheap either. Very disappointing.

Very tacky and hard to spread / dab under the eye. Not a fan. The last thing I wanna do is stretch the skin back and forth under my eyes...I'm 52 and trying not to manipulate my already sensitive skin :). Not able to wear any makeup over the eye cream -- it stays sticky for way too long.

extraits.titre: Make sure you get the soft cream!
extraits.texte: Great new texture with the soft cream - I would advise anyone with combo skin - sensitive etc… to use the soft cream - this was the only product that made me break out - the I switched and it was like night and day - use it with the wrinkle eye cream - and you can use anytime - it's great for the winter! I like to use at night and use my age defender during the day. Both are phenomenal ( for me )
My eyes are very sensitive and your cream does not irritate the skin around my eyes. I am disappointed, however, that it is not longer offered in a sealed pump container

extraits.titre: Leaves face moisturized without greasy feeling
extraits.texte: I love this product! A little goes a long way! Feels amazing on my face, neck and décolleté! Non-greasy or oily feeling! It's the perfect nighttime treatment and my face feels moisturized and refreshed in the morning on my very dry skin!

After trying numerous eye creams to combat severe dry skin (and prevent aging signs), this cream is awesome (even better than the ones the derms recommended). It's light, yet creamy. It absorbs fast and the skin around the eyes definitely looks more fresh.
